name: iota-dashboard
description: mac-miner online dashboard and self-hosted API for IOTA and NOID mining

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && npm run build --workspace=iota-miner-tools && npm run build --workspace=miner-agent && npm run build:server
scripts.test:local-tools: python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 9) else 1)' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v || echo '跳过本地工具测试（需要 macOS 与 Python 3.9+）'
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=iota-miner-tools && node --test packages/iota-miner-tools/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:local-tools && npm test --workspace=miner-agent && npm run test:server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist/web
